This goal is solved by developing a method of calculating the dynamic load on the foot, which boils down to determination of the coefficients to solubility and the coefficient of dynamic load. It’ s established that the maximum value of dynamic support per unit of time falls on the front of the foot, the minimum - on the middle section.

articleTitle: Ferroelectric nanocomposites: Influence of nanoparticle size distribution on electrocaloric conversion parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The study of the electrocaloric effect in ensembles of ferroelectric nanoparticles is of significant interest for fundamental research and its practical applications in solidstate coolers. The exploration of electrocaloric cooling is of great importance to finding solutions to environmental and energyefficiency issues in currently available refrigeration technologies. In this work we calculated the polarization, electrocaloric temperature change, and dielectric permittivity of the nanocomposite containing non-interacting ferroelectric nanoparticles with different size distributions, and analyzed the dependences of polarization, dielectric permittivity and electrocaloric temperature change on the distribution function of the particles sizes. As anticipated, the properties of the nanocomposite approach that of the average size nanoparticles with a narrowing in the dispersion of particles sizes within the nanocomposite.

articleTitle: Modeling of Multiwave Pumped Fiber Raman Amplifier for C+L Telecommunication Windows
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Modeling results for broadband fiber Raman amplifier (FRA) with flat gain parameters over very wide spectral range covering the C+L telecommunication windows are presented in our paper. Multiwave pumped FRA with active media True Wave singlemode fiber type is analyzed in comparison with erbium doped fiber amplifier. Numerical data for multimode Gaussian decomposition of Raman gain profile in True Wave fiber type for telecommunication are resulted. It is shown the almost exact approximation of the Raman gain profile can be obtained in analytical form for the True Wave fiber over the working bandwidth up to 20 THz. It is the analytical form of gain profile greatly simplifies the modeling procedure and main gain parameters for 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 wavelengths pumped FRAs are presented.

articleTitle: DFT Study of H2, H2O, and O2 Adsorption on Ni(111) Surface
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Nickel sensor action for analytical detection of hydrogen and oxygen gases is dependent on the adsorption, dissociation, and diffusion of hydrogen and oxygen. These processes and water adsorption was studied by the density functional theory with model Ni(111) slabs. It was found that H atoms were absorbed only by voids in the fcc structure as the Ni surface was filled. The voids in the fcc sites were also preferred for the adsorption of oxygen atoms and oxygen-hydrogen pairs. Two bridge adsorption forms of water were found in addition to the well-known, top-site adsorption form.

articleTitle: Features of electrical conductivity in nanocomposite polymer electrolytes based on polyethylene glycol, LiClO4 and organomodified laponite
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: We investigated the features of conductivity of polymer electrolytes based on polyethylene glycol, LiClO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and organomodified laponite using the method of impedance spectroscopy. It is shown that the electrical conductivity of PEG-based systems is significantly dependent on the salt content. It is found that the conductivity has an extreme dependence on the LiClO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> content. At a salt concentration of Li/O = 1/4, the conductivity of the system is independent of temperature, indicating the formation of ionic aggregates. The introduction of laponite nanoparticles (1%) into the polymer electrolyte leads to an increase in electrical conductivity by reducing the crystallinity and destruction of ionic aggregates. Further increase in the content of the filler reduces the electrical conductivity.

articleTitle: Using Brain-Computer Interface for Measuring Indicators of Cognitive Processes (A Case of Doing Educational Reading)
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Students' cognitive processes while their learning activities strongly influence the effectiveness of education. The indicators of such processes can be determined using an electroencephalogram analysis and, as a consequence, the success of educational process as a whole can be predicted. For this analysis, alpha and beta rhythms are traditionally used. It may be of interest to use complex indicators, characterizing several rhythms, and alternative types of rhythm, for example, theta rhythm, to improve measurement accuracy. To make it possible to use theta rhythm and to assess the level of understanding and interest of the text viewed, the preliminary experiment was carried out. The results of the experiment demonstrate that the maximum value of the dominant frequency of theta rhythm was observed in case of uninteresting or unfamiliar reading. The effect of font size on the performance of cognitive processes was also studied.

articleTitle: Plasma Hydrodynamics in the Generalized Lorentz Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Completely ionized plasma is investigated in the generalized Lorentz model in which ions form an equilibrium subsystem. Hydrodynamics of electron subsystem is built taking into account component temperatures and velocities relaxation (equalization). The investigation is conducted in the Chapman-Enskog method in the Bogolyubov approach which based on his idea of the functional hypothesis. Electron distribution function in the main in the gradients of hydrodynamic variables approximation is found exactly without assumption that differences between component velocities and temperatures are small. Basic equations of the hydrodynamics are obtained with account for dissipative processes. Important application of the developed theory is a generalization of the standard theory of metals and semiconductors.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Assessment of Blood Glucose Changes with Near Infrared Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The results of the investigation of changes in optical signals of earlobe sensor at 660 and 940 nm and three-wavelengths finger sensor at 660, 850 and 940 nm during performance of 2-hour carbohydrate tolerance test are reported. Carbohydrate tolerance test (CTT) is known as the effective method of in vivo experiments to achieve a fairly wide range of glucose concentrations over a limited period of time. Measurements were carried out for 16 days in 4 non-diabetic volunteers. The results of the present study indicate that a definite optical response to the increase in blood glucose levels during the CTT, expressed after 40 min after carbohydrates uptake is observed at a wavelengths of 850 and 940 nm. The calibration coefficients were determined with the invasive glucometer and the glucose measurement errors on the Clark grid were analyzed. For the development of an optical sensor suitable for non-invasive measurement of blood glucose, further research with the use of other wavelengths in the near infrared range and technical implementation of the control of external parameters (temperature, pressure, humidity, etc.) are required.

articleTitle: Simulation of Radio Waves Focusing by a Two-Dimensional Parabolic Mirror Made from Parallel Dielectric, Dielectric-Graphene and Conducting Cylinders
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The scattering of a plane electromagnetic wave of TE polarization by a structure of N cylinders located along a parabola is numerically modeled. For this purpose the problem of diffraction of a plane wave by a cylinder with arbitrary center coordinates is solved. The mutual influence of individual cylinders is not taken into account at the calculations. When solving, Bessel functions of the complex argument were used. The aim of the work is to study the focusing of electromagnetic radiation of various frequencies at different sizes and materials of the threads. A study was made of the behavior of the field in the vicinity of the focus of the parabolic antenna under consideration for cylinders of a dielectric, a dielectric with a layer of graphene, and cylinders with perfect conductivity. It was found that the graphene layer leads to an almost twofold increase in the field amplitude at the focus. The size of the focal spot was studied depending on the frequency of the incident field, the radii of the cylinders, and the distance between the cylinders. It is shown that the field in the vicinity of the focus has some features, namely, there are slow and fast oscillations of the field amplitude with a change in the frequency of the incident wave. It turned out that slow variations are determined by the radius and properties of the cylinder material, but the reason for the fast oscillations in the framework of the model used was not found.

articleTitle: Interleaved Single-Phase Quasi-Switched Boost and Active Quasi-Z-Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In this paper two interleaved topologies with modified modulation techniques are proposed for single-phase application. Two modified modulation techniques based on maximum boost control technique and quasi-sinusoidal modulation strategy are proposed for the interleaved topology. The proposed interleaved topologies are validated with simulation using PSIM software and the simulation results are compared with interleaved quasi-z-source inverter topology. The comparison results show that the proposed topologies perform better using quasi-sinusoidal modulation technique. The interleaved quasi-switched boost inverter topology has the advantage of reduced passive components with higher output power compared to interleaved quasi-z-source inverter topology. The benefits of interleaved active quasi-z-source inverter topology are better utilization of the dc-link and higher efficiency.

articleTitle: Multichannel Positron-Positronium Trapping Models for Nanovoids Characterization of Functional Materials
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Multichannel positron and positronium trapping models were proposed to interpretation of free volume changes sin nanostructured materials for electronics. Proposed models were applied to study of nanovoids in chalcogenide glasses for optical sensors and spinel ceramics for humidity sensors. It is shown that two-state positron trapping model at two-component fitting procedure can be used to investigation of free volumes in compact matrix such as glasses. Multichannel positron-positronium trapping model can be applied to study of free-volume defects in materials with advanced nanoporous structure such as humidity-sensitive ceramics.

articleTitle: Detection of Respiratory Diseases Using Bispectral Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The subject of this study is the lung sounds of healthy people and patients suffering from bronchitis and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. The aim of the study were to identify the characteristic features of lung sounds of healthy and sick people, using bispectral analysis method, and finding the differences between them. This helps to differentiate patients according to their bronchopulmonary system state. As a result based on the identified features, an algorithm has been developed and proposed which can be used by a pulmonologist in the diseases diagnosis.

articleTitle: Reactive Ion Beam Sputtered Molybdenum Oxide Thin Films for Optoelectronic Application
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Molybdenum oxide thin films were synthesized by reactive ion beam sputtering technique. The effect of deposition temperature and annealing on surface morphology, electrical and optical parameters of molybdenum oxide thin films and heterojunctions based on them were determined. In particular, obtained thin films exhibit photosensitive properties (photo-sensitivity coefficient is about 200 μA/1mV), heterojunctions based on them are characterized by the rectifying properties (rectification coefficient is almost 300 at applied voltage of 0.5V) and photovoltaic properties (open-circuit voltage is 215 mV and short-circuit current with one point contact is up to 2.4 mA).

articleTitle: Computer model for heat stress prediction during physical activity
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The study of thermal status in man during physical activity in hot environment is actual task as the metabolic heat rate increases essentially and it appears danger of hyperthermia. Modeling is the scientific method that allows to get preliminary answer and to avoid health hazard. The purpose of this paper is to develop and to test new mathematical model for prediction of temperature dynamics of man during human performance in hot environment. It focuses on combined challenge of physical activity and hot environment. The new model takes into consideration exercise intensity and exposure time, environmental characteristics - air temperature, relative humidity and wind velocity. The model represents thermoregulatory responses to exercise and hot environment: vasodilatation of skin to transfer metabolic heat from core to surface and sweating to dissipate heat through sweat evaporation in environment. The model takes into account heat production, heat transfer and heat exchange with environment. The model provides opportunity to obtain recommendations and conclusions on the danger to continue performance in given environment.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Data Acquisition And Power Quality Analyzing System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: A low-cost customizable PC-based power quality analyzer is proposed. It consists of a data acquisition unit built using a ARM microcontroller, which performs measurement functions and primary filtering and processing of the voltage and current signals, and can either transmit data to computer via virtual serial port and/or store the measurement results to a flash SD memory card for subsequent processing and analysis. The data acquisition unit has built-in real-time clock (RTC), can operate in autonomous mode, without PC connection. It is possible to define software triggers for start/stop recording conditions, including recording in specified periods of time (using RTC). For convenience, 4 discrete inputs were added with universal operating voltage range (24...220 V AC/DC) to allow recording triggering by external signal. The objective was to built a low-cost system, so data acquisition unit has no display; to reduce gain and phase errors of current clamps, a negative impedance converters were used as their loads; furthermore, an additional software filtering is performed to compensate for residual errors. A simple software for PC was also developed to allow simple signal processing and ability to export signal data to MathCad for further analysis.

articleTitle: Operator of the Dynamic Process of the Appearance of Acoustic Emission Signals During Deforming the Structure of Materials
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental studies of the energy spectrum of acoustic signals of the precursor model of damage in the process of deformation of media with a microstructure are presented. The regularities of changes in the oscillatory properties of acoustic emission signals with force field parameters are established. The existence of a correspondence between changes in energy characteristics of molecules and the moments of occurrence of acoustic emission signals is proved. A meaningful interpretation of the operator structure of dynamic processes and numerical methods for recovering information about the strength properties of materials from the characteristics of the initiation sources of acoustic emission signals is given.

articleTitle: Modifications of recognition procedures of biomedical signals using shape characteristics for their description and in decision criteria
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The order of obtaining and evaluating the effectiveness of modifying the recognition procedures of biomedical signals using the characteristics of their shape for describing observed processes and in decision-making criteria are considered. The presentation is illustrated by an example with three types of signals with their classification - N, A, and V types of QRS complexes in a half-hour ECG recording of the patient.

articleTitle: Electrical Properties of Semiconducting Heterometallic (Copper, Yttrium)-Containing Acetylacetonate
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: A technique for synthesizing a complex compound of tetrakis-µ3-(methoxy)(methanol)pentakis (acetylacetonato)(tricopper (II), yttrium (III)) methanol (I) has been developed. A press for making a cylindrical specimen has been applied to measure the electrical conductivity of the powder-like extracted compound. There have been calculated the density of this substance in a compressed state, the molecule mass, the number of molecules in the test cylindrical specimen volume, the charge carrier concentration, the bandgap. Dependence of the specific resistance on temperature has been investigated, dependence of the charge carrier concentration on temperature has been investigated, dependence of the quantum Hall coefficient on temperature has been investigated, and dependence of the Hall voltage on the magnetic field induction has been investigated.

articleTitle: Quantifying the contrast of objects in a complex image
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of no-reference quantitative assessing the overall contrast in an image. The purpose of this work is to increase the accuracy of quantifying the contrast for complex images. To this end, this paper proposes a new approach to assessing the overall contrast of objects in an image, which based on the analysis of the contrast value of simple images at various given levels of adaptation. Based on this approach, new techniques proposed to quantify the summary contrast of objects of complex multi-element images using the linear and weighted contrast kernels. The proposed technique is parameter-free, simple to implement, computationally low-costs, and can be recommended for image quality assessment in realtime mobile applications.

articleTitle: Interaction of K2CrO4 Oxide Nanoparticles with Carbon Nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Interactions of the surfaces of potassium chromate crystal nanoparticles with carbon nanotubes and graphene are computationally studied by the electronic structure calculations within the molecular cluster approach. Three types of carbon nanostructures were considered in calculations: single-walled (~ 0.7 nm in diameter) and multiwalled carbon nanotubes (~ 5 nm in diameter), fragments of graphene sheet. Potassium chromate crystal fragments of linear sizes ranging from ~0.5 to ~2 nm (chromate anion and potassium chromate clusters consisting of 1 – 32 formula units of the crystal) were modeled in calculations. The results of the calculations revealed the mechanism of bonding between oxide crystal fragments and carbon nanostructures. It was found that the graphene sheet most effectively interacts with such a surface of the potassium chromate crystal that contains the most possible number of potassium cations. It was shown that the interaction of single-layer graphene sheets with fragments of potassium chromate having linear dimensions of several nanometers leads to significant distortion (twisting) of the graphene sheet. Conclusions regarding the possibility of efficient adsorption of crystal nanoparticles by the surfaces of real carbon nanostructures were made.

articleTitle: Hardware-Software Complex to Diagnostic and Rehabilitation the Patients with Damages of Cervical-Thoracic Spine and Hand Nerves
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: After the damages of the cervical-thoracic spine and hand nerves, the motor and/or sensory functions are impaired, especially fine motor skills of each finger individually or a group of fingers. In the paper is proposed a method of constructing a “green zone” (optimal for patient training mode), and “red zone” (dangerous training mode), which correspond to the model of quantitative dependence the time fulfill several sequential actions patient based on the moving average. A decrease of muscle spasticity of the arm in scores following the Modified Ashworth Scale (MAS) was used as a criterion of optimality. For medical studies and training the diagnostic and training (DT) devices of the “Reflex-Txx” series were developed, which has in-built Hall sensors or touch sensors. The results of each individual's training are accumulated, displayed and analyzed on the microservices of the developed hardware and software complex and available on the user's gadgets. The electronic components and architecture of the developed devices based on a cost-effective Arduino platform hardware implementation.

articleTitle: Modified Pearson Model for High-Energy Multi-Charge Implantation and Impurity Activation for Sensor Microsystems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The mathematical Gauss and Pearson models, that qualitatively determine the physical processes of ion doping of acceptor (p) and donor (n) impurities, are used for the simulation of silicon submicron large scale integrated (LSI) structures. Such models are the basis of CAD-technology for calculating the concentration profiles of diode and transistor structures. This paper presents a modified Pearson model, which with high accuracy simulates the process of dual multicharge implantation of boron (B<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, B<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">++</sup>) and phosphorus (P<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, P<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">++</sup>) ions at the process of the formation of the isotype p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> -p and n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> -n contacts, which at present form the basis of combined drain-source areas of the CMOS submicron high speed structures.

articleTitle: Methods for Computing the Radiation Characteristics of Airborne Aperture Antennas Placed under Radomes of Various Shapes
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: We present and discuss a numerical method for the computation of radiation characteristics of the aperture antennas protected with various dielectric radomes. This method enables one to calculate the field, radiated from an aperture in a perfectly absorbing screen in the presence of a radome or some other scattering object. Using this method, we obtain the far-field radiation patterns for sample antennas with dielectric radomes of several shapes. The method allows selecting the thickness of radome that is optimal for minimizing the signal distortions caused by the protective radome. It can also be applied in the numerical design of two-layer radomes.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Space Resolving Ability of Open Coaxial UHF Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Theoretical analysis of the microwave sensor spatial resolution is presented. The sensor is an open coaxial aperture. It allows you to concentrate the electromagnetic field in a small area that is significantly less than the wavelength. This allows using it as a sensor of nano-objects. Such a sensor can operate in a wide frequency range. This increases information efficiency in indirect measurements. A rigorous analytical model can be created for it. The solution of the problem is based on an analytical description of the fields in the working area of such a sensor using an existing model. Based on the analysis of the field distribution in the working area, factors that influence resolution are identified. The presented results show that the axial and radial spatial resolution of the OCS depends on the minimum dimensions of the elements forming the aperture. The results of calculations of the components of the electromagnetic field in the working area of the sensor are discussed.

articleTitle: Efficiency Gain of Silicon Solar Cells Through Using of Multitextures
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Application of the porous silicon multitextures as an efficient and commercially viable coating has to be maximally adapted to processes of the silicon solar cell manufacturing. The possibility to create the porous silicon multitexture as a basic material for the fabrication of efficient solar cells is shown. As a result of electrochemical etching, the columnar porous silicon texture was fabricated in terms to obtain a low-reflection structure. The reflection of prepared frontal texture based on columnar porous texture exhibited lower values in comparison to the random pyramid texture in the wavelength range 400-1150 nm. It was demonstrated higher photovoltaic performances of test solar cells with a columnar porous silicon texture in comparison to those with pyramidal textures.

articleTitle: The explosive crystallization process in binary amorphous alloys Ni-Zr system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: A series of theoretical calculations have been carried out to analyze the possibility of the explosive crystallization process under laser treatment of binary amorphous alloys based on the Ni-Zr system. The characteristics of the crystallization process were calculated for two cases: slow heating of amorphous specimen with speed 0,16 K/s and an instant laser pulse, and heating of amorphous specimen by a laser beam to a certain temperature within 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> seconds. The high heating rates, achieved by the laser treatment of amorphous alloys, create a number of differences in the course of crystallization processes compared with crystallization during slow isothermal annealing. According to the calculations for Ni64Zr36 alloy, impulse heating to temperatures below 525 K does not cause crystallization. After 526 K there are significant changes in the kinetics of crystallization. At 527 K, the crystalline phase part has reached the value 8%. In the interval from 527 K to 528 K there is a sharp jump in the value of the crystal phase proportion from 8% to 97%, that is, a complete crystallization of the amorphous alloy occurs. In this way it is shown that under laser annealing in binary amorphous alloy based on Ni-Zr system there can be a phenomenon of explosive crystallization at a temperature which is 70 K lower than the temperature of the intensive crystallization beginning at slow heating.

articleTitle: Nucleation in the Process of Cu-Sn Alloy Nanoscale Films Electrodeposition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The results of a study of nucleation and growth of nuclei in polyligand pyrophosphate-trilonate electrolyte for Cu-Sn alloy deposition are presented. It is shown that the current transients obtained in a wide range of alloy deposition potentials correspond to the model of instantaneous formation of 3D crystals with diffusion control. The number of nuclei N increases from 0.19,108 cm-2 to 2.05,108 cm-2 with increase in polarization of the electrode. The thickness of continuous films is in the range of 3.6-10.2 nm depending on their deposition potential.

articleTitle: The method of digital holographic interferometry for research of dental implants
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The method for measuring the axial deformations of dental implants with the use of digital holographic interferometry is developed. The optical scheme for registration of digital holograms of diffuse objects is developed and optimized. The software has been developed for recording, processing and reconstruction of digital holographic interferograms. Special equipment has been created for fastening and dosed load of dental implants. The experimental dependence obtained during the study shown that popular today titanium abutments take less deformation under mechanical load than abutments from ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Also, the same dependency for the implant length is shown.

articleTitle: Heat Exchange Simulation Of The Method And Portable Device For Measuring The Emissivity
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: A new method of measuring the emissivity is proposed, which is a combination of the relative radiation and calorimetric methods and allows to compensate for the influence of the convective component of heat exchange in the measuring cell. Conducted here is the computer simulation of complex radiation and convective-conduction heat exchange processes in cylindrical working cells of a portable device for measuring the emissivity. It has been established that the convective heat exchange in the cell is commensurate with the radiation heat exchange and leads to an uneven distribution of heat flow on the surface of the sensor.

articleTitle: Reducing the influence of interference in DVB-C and IPTV
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The influence of random noise on the number of errors in cable and Internet television systems is investigated. An alternative approach to the principle of data transfer based on existing equipment is formulated. The requirements for the simulator for modeling the process of data transfer are formulated. Models of coding and decoding blocks are proposed. The possibility of modeling the effect of interference in the Matlab system at a logical level is investigated. The content of an alternative approach to data transmission consists in replacing an information bit with a logical vector. The logical convolution of the direct and mirror logical vector is carried out on the receiving side. The convolution operation is performed by software without the use of analog-to-digital conversion of the received signal. The advantage of the proposed principle of redundancy of information is that the implementation is feasible for both cable and Internet television. In the latter case, a positive effect is achieved when there is free traffic. The application of this approach for cable television is justified in the presence of free carriers (subcarriers). This proposal is also of interest for technical television systems operating in the conditions of interference, for which the reliability of data transmission takes precedence over other parameters.

articleTitle: The Use of Cumulant Methods for Distinction of Diagnostic Signals with Gamma Distribution
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Based on the cumulant coefficients - skewness and excess kurtosis, the problem of distinction of diagnostic signals having gamma distributions with different values of the shape parameter is considered. For the given probabilities of diagnostic errors, the threshold values and minimum sample sizes were obtained for two cases - when using one of the coefficients and a pair of coefficients. The reliability of the distinction of diagnostic signals is confirmed by the results of computer simulation of signal realizations and estimates of their cumulant coefficients.

articleTitle: Using of Data Mining methods to evaluate the myocardial damage in children with juvenile idiopathic arthritis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: This study is aimed to assess validity the system of comprehensive ECG scoring, using Data Mining. The regression and classification models of complex index of functional state were developed. Cluster analysis and decision trees algorithms (CART) were used for identification subgroup of patients. Predictive indices for diagnosis of the functional state of the cardiovascular system of children with juvenile idiopathic arthritis were selected.

articleTitle: Influence of Ba/Cu Ratios on the Formation and Electrical Properties of the Barium Cuprate Phases
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: For the ternary system Ba-Cu-O, the polycrystalline samples with different Ba/Cu ratios were prepared at interaction between barium nitrate and copper (II) oxide. Using XRD phase analysis, have determined phase composition of the synthesized complex oxide and analyzed variation of powder diffractograms with thermal treatment time. It was found that formation of single-phase products occurs at Ba/Cu ratios 1: 1 and 2:3. The electrical properties of cuprates were studied with the impedance spectroscopy technique, while the oxygen index was determined using iodometric titration.

articleTitle: Effectiveness assessing of softwares with AI for chest area x-ray images post-processing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Diagnostic radiology is a branch of medicine describes of ionizing radiation using to study the structure and functions of normal and pathological altered human organs and systems for the prevention and detection of diseases. X-ray irradiation is the most common diagnostic method in Radiology and it makes possible to identify and diagnose diseases and injuries for further treatment of patients. In particular, development of artificial intelligence (AI) has led the creation of different software for X-ray images processing to improve pathologists recognition by operator. At this moment there are lots of means and methods have been developed by different software engineers to find out “the perfect solution” for this problem. Respiratory diseases occupy one of the leading places in Ukraine. The main share of pathologies is acute viral infections, bronchitis, pneumonia and tuberculosis. In one year, about 15.5 million chest X-ray studies perform in Ukraine only for tuberculosis detection. It was the reason to select chest X-ray studies for processing's effectiveness assessing. For effectiveness assessing we have made quantitative contrast measurements for selected areas on original and processed chest X-ray images.

articleTitle: Image Preprocessing for Eye Pupil Tracking
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The influence of image preprocessing methods on the quality of eye pupil tracking by video is investigated. The methods of blurring, sharping, contrasting and scaling are considered. An estimate of the signal-to-noise ratio for image recognition based on the signal spectrum is proposed. The results obtained make it possible to determine combinations of image preprocessing modes that give the best pupil detection accuracy and a sufficiently high frame processing speed.

articleTitle: Automated Stereotactic Standardization of Brain SPECT with 99mTc-HMPAO
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: A method of automatic spatial standardization of SPECT images of brain was developed. The average error estimate of the spatial rotation angles of 3D images is in the range of 0.8-4 degrees. The presented standardization method of SPECT images of brain has been implemented in “ScintyBrain” software and it is recommended for the preliminary treatment of the data, especially in the absence of serious functional changes in the brain perfusion.

articleTitle: On the Possibilities of Controlling the Dynamic Properties of Cylindrical Piezoceramic Radiators in Telecommunication Problems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: For telecommunication tasks, the possibilities of controlling the electrical dynamic acoustic properties of cylindrical piezoceramic radiators formed from two coaxial piezoceramic shells with taking into account the coupling of physical fields acting in the radiators and varying the excitation and design parameters of the radiators are determined from the electrical side. Based on the analytical relationships obtained by the coupled field method in multiply connected regions, quantitative dependencies between the amplitude-frequency characteristics of the acoustic pressure in the far field and the excitation parameters (the ratio of the amplitudes of the voltages supplied to the shells and the phase difference between the voltages) and the structure (the ratio of shell thicknesses to radii). A number of regularities in the obtained dependences are found, demonstrating the potential possibilities and ways of controlling the dynamic properties of the complex radiators under consideration. A physical analysis of the causes of the appearance of such patterns is presented.

articleTitle: On the Peculiarities of Matching an Electric Generators with an Electromechanical Energy Transducers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: A study of the features of matching an electric generator with an electromechanical energy transducer in process of constructing radiation path for a system of electromechanical transducers made from piezoelectric ceramics was conducted. Two approaches to the construction of equivalent circuit of electromechanical energy transducers in the problems of matching them with exciting electric generators are presented. These approaches are associated with the representation of the computation models of transducers in the form of systems with lumped or distributed parameters.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of non-Metallic Inclusions on the Wear Resistance of the Weld Metal
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The paper presents investigation of methods of injecting of nanocomponents into the welding pool, that are adapted for surfacing processes. They differ by form and way of injecting. A mixture of nanopowder with flux, spray technology, a mixture with alcohol and a paraffin rod were tested during research. Silicon oxide nanopowder and carbon fiber have shown a positive effect on the durability. Positive changes in the structure of weld metal and microhardness increase were detected when using nanocomponents. To assess the role of non-metallic inclusions on the structure of the surface, welds were examined for their chemical composition, dimensions and density of precipitates in a metal matrix. Statistical analysis of non-metallic inclusions in the weld metal was done. It has shown that cumulant coefficients and probability density functions of diameters of equivalent circles of non-metallic inclusions are sensitive to various types of additives in steel.

articleTitle: Miniature ultrasonic transducer for lab-on-a-chip applications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: An ultrasonic transducer made from LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> was designed and manufactured using periodically poled domain technology. The working frequency of the transducer with the linear dimensions of 0.5×1×2 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> was about 60 MHz. The transducer is designed to excite longitudinal waves in liquids and can be used as an acoustic mixer, atomizer or part of a sonochemical reactor. It is believed that the better understanding of the frequency aspects of ultrasonic generators and actuators will facilitate the development of new trends in Lab-on-a-chip technologies, which enable a number of applications, particularly, in biomedicine.

articleTitle: The effect of oxidation on the surface properties and modification of carbons: a DFT study
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Bromination and oxidation are concurrent reactions that passed on the surface of carbon solids and carbon nanomaterials. In this study, their products were modeled for a hexagonal carbon network that forming a honeycomb 2D planar structure made of sp2-hybridized bonded carbon. Two types of active centers, namely, HC=CH and C-H groups linked to peripheral zigzag carbon atoms, were considered during the DFT simulations. The oxidation process is more advantageous than bromination. Free active centers, even that on the oxidized surface, maintain their ability to the bromine addition reaction. However, the probability of their existence on the oxidized surface is very low. The active centers of the surface can be renewed by the removal of oxygen-containing groups at thermal treatment in an inert atmosphere.

articleTitle: Nanosized Materials Based on SnO2 for Adsorption Semiconductor Gas Sensors
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Nanosized tin dioxide with an average particle size 5-6 nm and specific surface area 110 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/g was obtained by a sol-gel technique using SnC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> as a precursor. Study of the temperature dependences of responses to hydrogen of the sensors created on the base of the synthesized nanosized SnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> with different content of carboxymethyl cellulose allow to found the optimal composition of the semiconductor paste applying to the sensor plates. Palladium containing sensor material on the base of the optimal composition paste was formed to create the sensor for detection methane in air. The sensor with palladium additive possess a high response to CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> in air and a fast response time. The sensor can measure methane in air in a wide range of its concentration (20-937 ppm). Synthesized nanomaterials are perspective to use them as gas sensitive layers of the semiconductor sensors purposed to determine toxic and combustible gases in air.

articleTitle: Luminescence centers in low-dimensional layered cadmium iodide crystals and nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: It has been established that dominant luminescence centers both in layered CdJ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> crystals and related to them nanostructures are associated donor-acceptor complexes of intrinsic point defects within the cation vacancy and interstitial cadmium. Layered structure results in two different types of such intrinsic donor-acceptor pairs with different spatial orientation: “cation vacancy - interstitial cadmium in the structural layer” and “cation vacancy-interstitial cadmium between the layers”. The reasons of Cd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup>-V V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cd</sub>- - Cd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> complexes creation are discussed and the result of their existence are proved in the appearance of a selective band around 3.23 eV in the region of fundamental absorption edge at low temperatures. An increase of the width of forbidden gap width occurs in thin CdJ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> films and nanostructures related to them. In the spectra of luminescent emission for the states 5p<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</sub> J →5s Cd (maximum at 315 nm) and 5p<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x,y</sub> → 5s Cd (maximum at 325 nm) an indirect band transition of exciton mechanism changes to direct one and so a discrete transition takes place.

articleTitle: Principle of Interharmonic Detection in Transformer of AC-DC Converter Based Double Fourier Series
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: low-frequency interharmonics cause magnetization of transformers of DC-DC and AC-DC converters. One of the causes of interharmonics is the interaction of the rectified voltage ripple and inverter voltage, whose frequencies are not multiples of each other. Detection of interharmonics is quite a challenge since the required time interval of observation depends on the frequencies of processes that are constantly changing. So, the calculation method has to describe the spectrum in a closed analytical form. Fourier series of one variable is inefficient because of the necessity of spectrum recalculation after frequency changing. In the paper Double Fourier series is proposed and adopted for interharmonics calculation. It implementation for AC-DC converter is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Acoustic Remote Sensing Piezoceramic Transducers with Internal Screen
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The analytical relationships, allowing to quantify the parameters of the cylindrical piezoceramic transducers with internal screens for remote sensing acoustic fields by means of the related fields method in multiply assessments of the resonance radiation spectra and the angular distribution features of acoustic fields at the resonant frequencies depending on the particular design of the sensing device are obtained. This became possible by taking into account connectivity of the acoustic, mechanical and electric fields when converting acoustic energy and acoustical relationship between the piezoceramic shell and the screen inside the transducer cavity.

articleTitle: Modelling of Airborne High-technological Coriolis Vibratory Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The paper deals with modeling of the high-technological Coriolis vibratory gyroscope with the metallic resonator. The gyroscope is characterized by the high accuracy, high resistance to shocks and comparatively low cost. It can be used both in aircraft control systems and test equipment. The basic technological errors have been analyzed. the mathematical model of the gyroscope was developed. Modelling of the above-mentioned device including measuring scale factor and drift determination were carried out.

articleTitle: Enhanced Frame-Similarity Technique for Detection of Respiratory and Cardiac Rhythms in Auscultation Records
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: An enhanced algorithm for recognizing the rhythms associated with cardiac and respiratory activity in auscultation signals has been developed on the basis of previously proposed approaches. The essence of this technique is to evaluate the energy similarity of fragments of the original record at their superposition with a progressive time shift. To estimate the time evolution of signal frequency content, the Short-Time Fourier Transform is applied to records obtained by the developed portable one-channel digital auscultation complex. The free terms of the linear regression model for “instant” amplitude-frequency spectrum calculated in four information-significant octaves with central frequencies of 63, 125, 250, and 500 Hz are chosen for a measure of acoustic energy variation. The procedure of averaging of initial sample at one-second time intervals is used to segregate the cardiac and respiration periodicity into “fast” and “slow” channels. It is shown that search for minimums of the introduced distances depicting the similarity of compared fragments provides a reliable tool for detecting of life activity rhythms contained in the auscultation signal.

articleTitle: Preliminary Statistical Analysis of Large Conductance Cationic Channels Flickering
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Ion channel flickering occurs mainly when the pore of the channel in its open state is mechanically blocked. Systematic analysis is required to evaluate the effectiveness of such blocking. We have proposed a method for analyzing the channel flickering based on beta distribution and cumulative diagrams on the example of Large Conductance Cationic Channels (LCC-channels) pores blocked by dithylinum. This is important for detecting the hidden effects of substances on these channels by causing an increase of temporal resolution.

articleTitle: Rate Vibratory Gyroscopes Bias Minimization by the Standing Wave Angle Installation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: this paper proposes a new simple technique for minimization of Coriolis vibratory gyroscope (CVG) initial bias. This technique can be applied to MEMS and non-MEMS rate CVGs. It can most effectively be used for low-cost CVGs which have the remaining mass imbalance resulting in Q-factor and frequency mismatches. The idea is based on dependency of a CVG bias and scale factor on standing wave angular position with respect to the drive electrode.

articleTitle: Compact Longitudinal Uniaxial Waveguide to Coaxial Connector
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Taking a known waveguide-coaxial connector as an example, this paper presents the research on the operation principles of this type of device. The report formulates the main requirements for the practical implementation of the longitudinal uniaxial waveguide to coaxial connectors. Example design of such a connector is demonstrated and discussed, as well as devices based on this solution.

articleTitle: New Approach for Currents Assessment in Single Ion Channels of Cardiac Cells Nuclei
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The most common method of investigation of bioelectric processes in ion channels involves statistical analysis of the measured amplitudes of currents during open and closed periods of channels by means of histograms. However, information on channel switching time or event origin is lost. The goal of this paper is to improve the assessment of ion functional properties using the signal processing methods, based on wavelet analysis of single channel recordings. To assess functioning of large-conductance cation channels (LCC-channels) the electrophysiological technologies on the base of experimental equipment with patch-clamp technique are used. Numerical experiments of signal processing demonstrate the advantages of the proposed approach, which is based on feature extraction of the currents of single channels in the time-sliding window. The proposed method allows for interpretation of experimental studying of functional properties of single channels without loss of temporal information. Wavelet decomposition is used to obtain undistorted morphologies of recordings. The proposed integral features, based on wavelet decomposition, allow us to estimate channel functioning under the influence of various drugs and can be used for classification of channel blocking mechanisms.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Transparency of Dielectric - Metal - Dielectric 1D photonic crystals in the THz Range
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The resonant linear and nonlinear transmission properties in THz range of structures dielectric-metal-dielectric ... are investigated theoretically. The thicknesses of metallic Ag or Au layers are of about 10 nm. The dynamics of the degenerated electron gas is described within the framework of the quantum hydrodynamic equations where the Bohm term is taken into account. To observe the resonant transmission, at the input there is a dielectric with a higher permittivity, whereas at the output is air. The incidence angle is chosen slightly below the full internal reflection angle. Because the nonlinearity of noble metals is high and almost dissipative, the nonlinearity results in the increase of the electron collision frequency. The transmission of THz electromagnetic waves increases sharply with the increase of the collision frequency. Thus the high dissipative nonlinearity in metals may play positive role in THz range for observing nonlinear phenomena in structures with thin metallic layers.

articleTitle: Digital X-ray Tomosynthesis Applications for Screening Racehorse Bone Tissue
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Race horses are often injured during races or training which leads to their high mortality including euthanasia. To reduce mortality, it is necessary to find a method that allows quickly and with high sensitivity to determine the condition of the animal's bone tissue before competition. At the same time, digital radiography, with its ease of use and high spatial resolution, does not have sufficient sensitivity, and computed x-ray tomography does not have sufficient resolution. Digital tomosynthesis is a new method in veterinary practice that allows obtaining highly informative sequences of images. The method proposed use the deviation contrast's measuring of images of tissues in the focus of the sesamoid bone and other bones of the horses fetlock joint.

articleTitle: IO Glitch Filter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In this paper one of the ways of reducing glitches that are present in the output of a simple CMOS inverter is described. This is done via RC filter. In this filter instead of resistor and capacitor MOS transistors are used, which will reduce the area of the circuit with cost of increased delay. Simulations are done under 1 GHz frequency. Under this condition the glitches were reduced by 76%, going down from 250 mV to 60 mV. All researches and simulations are done using Synopsys Armenia Educational Department's SAED 32/28 nm CMOS technology and HSPICE simulator.

articleTitle: Nanosized Oxide Materials: Morphology, Phase Composition and Catalytic Activity in CO Oxidation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Nanosized oxides and oxide nanocomposites with various composition on their base with an average particle size 3-47 nm were obtained by a citrate method. Effect of the composition and morphology on catalytic activities in CO oxidation of Co-, Mn-, Cu-, Ce-containing oxide nanozised materials has been studied. It was shown that a doping of cobalt-containing catalysts with manganese, copper and cerium oxides resulted in high dispersed states of these oxide components. Higher catalytic activities of the oxide nanocomposites in comparison with individual nanosized oxides can be caused by the presence of the active oxygen species formed on the interfaces of the oxide particles. The synthesized nanosized oxide composites as active catalysts in CO oxidation are perspective to use them as catalytically active additives to gas sensitive layers of semiconductor sensors purposed to determine carbon monoxide in air.

articleTitle: 9,10-diphenylanthracene/Polyvinylbutyral/Glassy Carbon Based Transducer: from Spin Coater Development to Electrochemiluminescent Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The work describes the development of a new electrochemiluminescent (ECL) transducer based on 9,10-diphenylanthracene (DPA) / polyvinyl butyral / glassy carbon film modified electrode along with the design and manufacture of a low-cost spin-coating system based on Arduino Atmega 2560, which was used to create the abovementioned transducer. It was proved that the performance of this spin coater is comparable to common commercial models, but with much lower total cost of the device. The appearance of ECL from DPA molecules of the transducer in reaction with a relatively new ECL co-reactant tetraphenylborate (TPB) in aqueous solution has demonstrated the applicability of spin-coating technique for creation of new types of ECL transducers. Application of such transducers allows full use of the unique properties of TPB co-reactant and eliminates a problem of formation of TPB based precipitates, which occurs when such common fluorophore as Ru(bpy)3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>+ is utilized.

articleTitle: The Thermal Fields Analysis of Sealed Cylindrical Piezoceramic Electroacoustic Transducers Compensated Construction
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The thermal fields of cylindrical piezoceramic electroacoustic transducers compensated designs sealed with metal-polymer layers are considered. The analysis on a basis of analytical calculations method and the finite element method was performed. The method of cylindrical piezoceramic electroacoustic transducers compensated construction thermal fields calculation based on the solution of the Fourier thermal conductivity differential equation is developed. The technique takes into account the features of the design implementation of transducers sealing by metal-polymer layers. A system of five infinite layers, each of which models a specific structural element of the transducer was taken as a calculation model. The solution of thermal conductivity equation which allows determine the temperatures at different points of the transducer layers is found. The investigation of cylindrical type transducer models with additional structural elements and without them using the finite element method in the SolidWorks program is carried out. Numerical calculations and comparison of thermal fields obtained by these two methods are performed. As a result of the analysis it is established that there is a significant temperature difference in the polymer membranes of the transducer construction which can lead to their destruction. The obtained results can be used during the cylindrical piezoceramic electroacoustic transducers designing.

articleTitle: Ageing Kinetics in Temperature Sensitive Thick Films Based on Spinel Ceramics
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Ageing kinetics in thick films based on Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</inf>Ni<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</inf> Co<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.6</inf>Mn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> spinel ceramics at temperature of 170 °C have been studied. Analytical description of processes in these materials was performed using five relaxation functions such as monomolecular, bimolecular, partly-generalized, DeBast-Gillard or Williams-Watts and fully-generalized. It is shown, that studied degradation kinetics are adequately described by DeBast-Gillard function in the form of compression-exponential relaxation with optimal number of fitting parametrs.

articleTitle: Coadsorption and Reaction of CO2, CO, and H2 on Ni-Fe(111) Surface
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Here we compared the results of density functional theory (DFT) modeling of adsorption on Ni-Fe(111) model surface and thermoprogrammed desorption studies of species adsorbed onto Ni-Fe catalysts during hydrogenation of the carbon dioxide (CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>). The DFT study showed that Fe atoms are not clustered in an environment of Ni atoms and are situated randomly far from each other. We have shown that CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> adsorbs slightly stronger on the Ni-Fe alloy than on pure nickel. We suggest that the optimal composition of bimetallic Ni-Fe catalysts should be about 8–10 at% of Fe in Ni. This statement is confirmed by our experimental data on the thermodesorption and catalytic activity of the Ni-Fe alloys in the methanation reaction. According to the data of thermal programmed desorption mass spectroscopy, the CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> molecule adsorbed on the surface of the Ni<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">75</inf>Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">25</inf>and Ni<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">80</inf>Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf> catalysts splits into CO* and O*. Resulting strongly chemisorbed CO prevents further hydrogenation reactions on the surface of the catalyst. The modeling does not answer the question of how iron influences the methanation reaction activity and selectivity.

articleTitle: Infrared Spectroscopy of Porous Silicon
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The paper deals with the study of the effect of the morphology and structure of crystallites of pSi layer. The porous layer was obtained by electrochemical anodization at anodizing current from10 to 60 mA and anodizing time from 5 to 30 minutes. The porous layer surface was studied with optical microscopy, and the crystallite structure was examined with FTIR technique. It has been discovered that the anodization modes have a direct effect on the deformation vibrations of the SiH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> group in the IR radiation propagation numbers from 700 to 950 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. At the boundaries of the crystallites compressing stresses arise causing a decrease in SiOSi bond in wave-numbers from 1060 to 1160 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. It has been demonstrated the increasing effect of SiH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> stretching bonds and SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</sub> complexes (absorption peaks 2116 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> and 2340 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> respectively). Due to combined calculation of free charge carriers concentration from the IR transmission spectra and electrical conductivity of porous silicon, the mobility of majority charge carriers is obtained. For p-type porous silicon, the conductivity mobility is μh=2.9×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/V×s, and for n-type porous silicon - μe=1.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/V×s.

articleTitle: Photocatalytic Properties of Metal-Semiconductor Nanosystems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In this work, the photocatalytic properties of TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>:S,C and TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>:S,C/Ag nanosystems were studied during the photodegradation of the Rhodamine G dye under the influence of semiconductor laser with the radiation wavelength of 450 nm. The gel paste based on an aqueous solution of polyvinyl alcohol, which contained 6% hydrogen peroxide, the Rodamin G dye and a different amount of nanopowder photocatalyst was prepared. The optimal concentrations for the photocatalytic dye decomposition reaction for each material were determined. It was shown that TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>:S,C nanosystem coated by silver nanoparticles has significant photocatalytic properties in the visible spectral range and significantly reduces the half-reaction time, compared to pure TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. This is an important characteristic for the wide practical application of the modified titanium dioxide as a nanophotocatalysts.

articleTitle: The Influence of the Characteristics of the Resonant Power Source on the Productivity of Electric-discharge Installations for Carbon-containing Gas Processing at Different Pressures in the Reaction Zone
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The influence of the output electrical characteristics of the resonant power sourse of high-voltage electrodischarge installations for the processing of carbon-containing gas to obtain carbon nanomaterials on their productivity at different pressures in the technological reactor was investigated. The regularities of the implementation of interdependent electrical and technological characteristics for the implementation of high-productivity obtaining of nanocarbon materials from carbon-containing gas have been determined. It is shown that with increasing pressure of carbon-containing gas in the reactor, it is possible to obtain higher productivity values at same interelectrode gap.

articleTitle: Grain-Porous Investigations of the Cu0.4Ni0.4Co0.4Mn1.8O4 Ceramics
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Phase compositions, microstructural properties and pore size distribution in the Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.8</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> ceramics in micro and macro modifications were investigated. It is shown that the micro and macro modified Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.8</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> ceramics are single-phase (contains only the main cubic spinel phase with cell parameter of 8.36504 (19) Åand 8.36505 (20) Å for the micro and macro modified Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.8</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, respectively). Different modifications of ceramics are displayed in the size and shape of pores. In micro modified Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.8</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> ceramics there is a more intensive growth of the contact area between the grains. increases the specific surface area. The grain is combined into agglomerates. One peak with nanopore with radius centered near ~ 2 nm is peculiar to macro modified Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.8</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> ceramics. Double maximum is characteristic to micro ceramics (~2.3 and 5.5 nm).

articleTitle: Resonance and Non-Resonance Interaction in Superradiance Modeling with Correlation Functions
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Our research into Dicke superradiance process is directed to building the connected picture of the behavior of emitter and field subsystems in order to elucidate the correlation properties of generated field. The interaction between subsystems has a resonant nature, so we can start from the fixed operation frequency of emitters. There are phenomenological methods for taking into account the frequency broadening of different natures. In our approach based on the Bogolyubov's functional hypothesis allowing the macrostate description with a limited number of parameters, some concepts of electrodynamics of continuous media are used and evolution equations of Maxwell type should be supplemented with material equations dependent on the operation frequency and field mode ones. Singularity in material coefficients disappears, if nonresonant interaction is considered. The manifestation of the role of nonresonant modes in field kinetics is a goal of this investigation.

articleTitle: Giant Magnetoresistance in the Deformed Microcrystals of Indium Antimonide
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Giant magnetoresistance (up to 700%) of the deformed InSb whiskers with doping concentration 6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup>-2×l0<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> was observed in magnetic fields with induction up to 10 T at temperature range 4.2-70 K. The effect was explained taking into account two-channel conductivity of the whiskers with core-shell structure. Besides, the obtained results were discussed in the framework of the quantum magnetoresistance theory. The obtained results allow to design the magnetic field sensor on the deformed InSb whiskers.

articleTitle: Mathematical Simulation of Emission Devices on Arrays of Carbon Nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: With the help of the described approaches to electric field (EF) modelling in the systems with carbon nanotubes (CNTs) arrays, analysis of such arrays parameters influence on the degree of the EF strength amplification on CNTs tips have been performed. Such approaches enable EF calculation at the applied computational grid step proportional to the CNTs height and for only one CNT from the array. Influence of correlation between the CNTs height, radius and distance between separate rods on the character of the EF distributions has been evaluated.

articleTitle: A Technology for Building a Seamless Mosaic Coverage of the Antarctica Coasts with Various-Time Images from Sentinel-1
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The necessity and relevance of the practical use of the Antarctica coast mosaics is described. The key points related to the technology of preparation of the Sentinel-1 scenes for building the mosaic are presented. Sentinel-1 scene search services are listed, along with existing products that provide Antarctic mosaics. The geometrical boundaries of the selected Sentinel-1 radar scenes for the created multi-time Antarctic coast mosaics are presented. The sequence of steps for preprocessing Sentinel-1 radar products is described. The Antarctica coastal part mosaic is being built on their basis. The main provisions of the method for constructing a seamless mosaic image are outlined. The stitching method of the scenes into a mosaic is based on the geometric analysis process of location of pixels overlapping in the scenes. The main results of method implementation are shown in a fragment of the Antarctica coverage mosaic. Experiments show that the technology can achieve automatic panoramic mosaic of the survey area.

articleTitle: Effect of Plasma-Chemical Synthesis Parameters on the Magnetic Properties of ferrite CO0,5Ni0,5Fe2O4
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Nanoparticles of cobalt ferrite (CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</sub>Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) were successfully synthesized by the method of low-temperature contact nonequilibrium plasma. The effect of the initial pH of the solution (8-12), processing temperature (20-40 °C), and the duration of low-temperature contact nonequilibrium plasma treatment on the coercivity and saturation magnetization was studied. Mathematical equations adequately describe the resulting dependence. The results showed that the pH of the reaction medium is the parameter that has the greatest effect on magnetic hysteresis for samples obtained by processing low-temperature contact nonequilibrium plasma.

articleTitle: Genetic Programming of Pipelined Datapaths for FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 40th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: A new method of the pipelined datapath synthesis which is based on the genetic programming approach is proposed. The method is based on the representation of the algorithm by the spaced synchronous data flow (SDF), transferring it to a chromosome, and using the conventional genetic optimization algorithm.
